snippet.title: [Flour Wars] Sous Vide Crème Brûlée
snippet.description:
The worst thing that can happen to a custard is when the mixture's temperature exceeds 85°C and starts to curdle. At this point you basically have scrambled eggs. The biggest problem with cooking custard in a water bath in the oven was that most of the cooking is accomplished through guess work, and it can quickly get out of hand. However, with the help of sous vide, you don't have to baby sit your perfect dessert any more!


Ingredients - Makes about Six 200ml containers worth
 - 150g Egg yolk
 - 90g Sugar
 - 2g Salt
 - 600g Heavy Cream
 - More sugar as needed



Original Recipe From
 - https://www.chefsteps.com/activities/creme-brulee

Music by Glassic
 - https://soundcloud.com/glassicprod/smooth-jazz-piano-instrumental

snippet.title: [Flour Wars] Kang Doenjang Stew - Korean Soup and Stews

Also, I didn't add any tofu to the recipe, but if you want you can add about 1/2 a block. Enjoy!

 - 3ea Shitake Mushroom
 - 1/2 Green Onion
 - 1/2 Onion
 - 1ea Red Pepper
 - 1ea Spicy Pepper


Kang Deonjand Paste
 - 2tsbp Gochujang
 - 4tbsp Deonjang
 - 1cup Rice Water*

*Rice Water - Waterused to rinse rice. It's a pale color. 


Stew
 - 1tbsp Sesame Oil
 - 1ea Handful of thinly sliced brisket
 - 2cup Rice Water (Add more if needed)
